units.source_text: 古歌：“离居各异地，白云重重隔。

en.t: An old poem says: Though we live apart in different places, layers of white clouds lie between us.

units.source_text: 寄语意中人，两心隔不得。”

en.t: Yet send word to the one you love: two hearts cannot truly be kept apart.
This appears in the Kokin Wakashu.

units.source_text: 又：“峰上白云多，何必来遮隔？

en.t: Another poem says: There are many white clouds above the peaks; why must they come to block and divide us?

units.source_text: 只有恋人心，白云遮不得。”

en.t: Only the heart of one in love cannot be hidden by white clouds.
